name: order_id
description: Unique identifier for each order (32-char hex hash)

name: customer_id
description: Foreign key to olist_customers_dataset. Each order has one customer.

name: order_status
description: Order status: delivered, shipped, processing, canceled, unavailable, invoiced, created, approved

name: order_purchase_timestamp
description: Timestamp when the customer placed the order

name: order_delivered_carrier_date
description: Timestamp when the order was handed to the logistics carrier

name: order_delivered_customer_date
description: Timestamp when the customer actually received the order

name: order_estimated_delivery_date
description: Estimated delivery date communicated to customer at purchase
